pairApplicability.note: Every response bid references an offered impression/item; auction identifiers match.

title: A JSON Feed 1.1 document as the response is recognized and honestly marked not validated

items.content_text: A short original item used only to exercise JSON Feed shape detection.

specNotes: JSON Feed 1.1 (jsonfeed.org, version+items shape) is not an OpenRTB response and this corpus does not treat it as a BidResponse pair; the base request stays a valid, independent oRTB BidRequest so the case can show what happens when a JSON Feed document lands in the response field of an otherwise normal request/response Inspector session.

Core's own design note (index.js, 'Honest non-validation') is the product's documented policy for this shape: recognize the format by its own version+items signature, return INFO rather than silently 'clean, no findings at all', and never run OpenRTB rules against fields that are not OpenRTB fields.

Crosscheck correctly refuses to compare a real BidRequest against a document with no `seatbid[]` (`crosscheck.no_response`), and must not report a false `crosscheck.id_match` — the JSON Feed document has no `id` field at all in the oRTB sense, and its `items[].id` is not an auction identifier.
